institution: Sri Pejavara Adhokshaja Matha (Panchanga published as Vishwesha Panchanga; one source, see DGE_Madhva_Acquisition_Architecture.md §14/§18/§20)
date_coverage: 2022 to 2026, special-day/festival annotations only (not full five-anga daily Panchanga)
rights_status: UNKNOWN - official Vishwesha Panchanga app; no explicit licence/redistribution terms observed
notes: This app's full daily five-anga Panchanga (tithi/nakshatra/yoga/karana per day) is NOT stored as readable text: assets/thithi.vss holds only a single year (2020) of special-day notes with the actual tithi/nakshatra/etc encoded as opaque numeric codes (e.g. '06010706') whose decode logic lives in the app's compiled B4A bytecode, not yet reverse-engineered. assets/1-2025.vss..12-2026.vss (the numbered monthly files) are JPEG calendar-page scans, not machine-readable data, despite the .vss extension -- confirmed by `file`, matching the same pattern documented for the sibling Udupi Panchanga app in the architecture doc §13. assets/ph.vss is a pontiffs' contact directory (names + personal phone numbers) -- NOT archived here on purpose; it is personal contact data and needs an explicit rights/consent decision before any use, per the architecture doc §49/§67. Full five-anga acquisition for this source is UNRESOLVED pending either (a) B4A bytecode reverse-engineering of the numeric-code decode logic, or (b) a runtime/network capture pass (§7-9 of the architecture doc).
